The report also includes the Statement of Financial Information (SOFI) for 2025. Jun 3, 2026 The Town of Osoyoos 2025 Annual Report is now available for review. The 2025 Annual Report is an opportunity for the community to learn about the Town and its performance over the last year. The report also includes the Statement of Financial Information (SOFI) for 2025.  A printed copy is also available to review at Town Hall. PUBLIC INPUT The public is invited to ask questions and give feedback on the 2025 Annual Report during the public inspection period starting Thursday, June 4, 2026. The report, along with any input received, will be presented to Council on Tuesday, June 23, 2026.  Ways to share feedback: • Share your feedback by email to info@osoyoos.ca • Mail or deliver written feedback to Town Hall • Speak at the Council meeting on Tuesday, June 23, 2026. The Town of Osoyoos will be considering the 2025 Annual Report at the Regular Open Meeting on Tuesday June 23, 2026, at 2:00 PM, at the Town Council Chamber at 8707 Main Street. Section 98 of the Community Charter sets out the requirements for municipalities to produce an Annual Report each year prior to June 30th. The report must contain: 1. audited financial statements, 2. report on permissive tax exemptions, 3. report on municipal services and operations for the previous year, 4. statement of objectives and measures for the current and next year. Hard copies of the Annual Report & Statement of Financial Information can be viewed in person at the Town Hall.
